events.action:
{"message": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/os/p4wq.c` in `item_lessthan()`.

### Cause
`item_lessthan(a, b)` checked `if (a->priority >= b->priority)` instead of `if (a->priority > b->priority)`. Because of the `>=` comparison, equal-priority work items unconditionally returned `true` (bypassing the `else if ((a->priority == b->priority) && ...)` deadline tie-breaker), causing `k_p4wq_submit()` to treat active items of the same priority and earlier deadlines as having lower priority than newly submitted items and unpending extra worker threads beyond the CPU count.

### Fix
Changed `a->priority >= b->priority` to `a->priority > b->priority` in `item_lessthan()` in `lib/os/p4wq.c`. All tests in `tests/lib/p4workq` now pass on `native_sim`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
